item.noTitle: No title in this language: this item is left out of lists and has no heading.

image.noTitle: This image has no title in the media library, so it has no alternative text.

richText.imageWithoutAlt: An image in this text has no alternative text: it is ignored by screen readers.
richText.tableWithoutCaption: A table in this text has no caption: give it one so that it can be found and understood.

cta.noTarget: No link target in this language
cta.noLink: This button has a label but no link: choose a page or a web address, or clear the label.

list.startMissing: The start folder is set but cannot be found here (deleted, or not published yet): the list shows nothing on the live site.

story.membersNotice: This story is for members. Sign in to read it in full.
story.membersEdit: Members only: visitors who are not signed in see the summary and a sign-in link.

feed.summary: Lists the stories ({{formats}}) under {{start}}, newest first, up to {{max}}.
feed.pageCategories: Only the stories filed under this page's categories.
feed.pageNoCategory: This page has no category: give it its topic as a category, or the feed shows nothing.
feed.noMatch: No story of this format here.

agenda.summary: Lists the sessions under {{start}}, by day in the {{zone}} time zone.

gallery.summary: Lists the people under {{start}} by name, up to {{max}}.
